items.title: Bitcoin could slide into the $50,000s as Fed rate hike bets build, Wintermute says
items.summary: Bitcoin may slide into the $50,000s after losing its 200-week average, with ETF outflows, weak demand and rate-hike risks weighing on BTC, leading market maker warns.

items.title: Cardano Foundation seeks $5 million from treasury using ADA price 33% above market
items.summary: The Foundation wants 25 million ADA for 12 global events, even as the token trades well below the 20 cent price used to size the request.

items.title: Wells Fargo's reported BlackRock bitcoin ETF holdings double to $2.35 billion
items.summary: The bank's reported BlackRock bitcoin ETF position doubled to $2.35 billion in the third quarter, giving it exposure to roughly 28,000 BTC.

items.title: Ripple-backed Evernorth has written down its pre-listing XRP holdings by 60%
items.summary: The company’s accounting policy requires it to record price declines without reversing those write-downs when XRP recovers.

items.title: Former Robinhood engineer pleads guilty to insider trading scheme on Hyperliquid
items.summary: Huaisong Xiang admitted using confidential crypto listing information to make $125,523 trading perpetual futures on Hyperliquid.

items.title: Bitcoin risks falling below $60,000 as Nvidia earnings threaten to deepen crypto sell-off
items.summary: Rising bond yields, ETF outflows and forced selling are weighing on bitcoin as traders brace for more losses.

items.title: U.S. Senate Democrats tell CFTC to back off its demand prediction markets defy bans
items.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission directed platforms such as Kalshi to defy state bans, but the Democrats want it to reverse course, citing court orders.

items.title: Lighter suspends all withdrawals after $10.4 million crypto exploit
items.summary: The decentralized exchange blamed a leaked trading API key and said its smart contracts were unaffected, while investigators traced funds to Hyperliquid.

items.title: Brazil's central bank faces backlash over stablecoin money laundering remarks
items.summary: A central bank official reportedly said legitimate funds become tainted when moved into stablecoins, comparing the market to the informal "dólar-cabo" system.

items.title: German parliament proposes crypto seizures without criminal charges
items.summary: German lawyers said a proposed law allowing the seizure of assets worth more than 100,000 euros could impose a burden of proof on crypto holders rather than the authorities.

items.title: US senators seek SEC answers on tokenized stock money laundering risks
items.summary: Four Democratic senators asked who would be responsible for tokenized shares transferred outside regulated platforms and whether the SEC could freeze or recover those tokens.

items.title: BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF snaps $2.35B outflow streak amid extreme fear
items.summary: BlackRock’s Bitcoin ETF ended 11 sessions of withdrawals totaling $2.35 billion, but CryptoQuant says one day of inflows is too early to signal a recovery.

items.title: Bitcoin realized loss metric beats June high as open interest eyes 2-year low
items.summary: Bitcoin short-term holders’ onchain spending notched the largest proportion of realized losses since February after BTC/USD dropped to $62,000.

items.title: Google says hackers use AI agents to find and exploit software flaws
items.summary: Google says attackers are using AI agents to find and exploit software flaws automatically, reducing the time organizations have to apply patches.

items.title: US judge clears brothers in $25M Ethereum MEV case after mistrial
items.summary: Judge Jessica Clarke said the transactions did not involve false promises, but the ruling did not determine whether the brothers’ conduct was ethical or violated other laws.

items.title: Goldman Sachs reports $1.22B in Ether ETFs as ETHA share count jumps
items.summary: Goldman Sachs increased its Ether ETF shares in Q3, bringing its reported holdings to $1.22 billion, while reshuffling its Bitcoin ETF positions.

items.title: Ex-Robinhood engineer pleads guilty to $125K Hyperliquid trading scheme
items.summary: The former Robinhood engineer used confidential information about upcoming Robinhood token listings to trade on Hyperliquid.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
items.summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

items.title: Trezor customer data exposed in 3rd partner breach this year
items.summary: Trezor warned an attacker has been able to access customer names, phone numbers and delivery addresses linked to 27,000 orders from one of its shipping providers.

items.title: Hackers inject credit card, crypto-stealing malware into 178 major websites
items.summary: Ledger and Coinpass were among the businesses whose websites served malware designed to steal visitors’ crypto and credit card details, according to security researchers.

items.title: Optimizely Hack Hijacked Ledger, BBC and 176 Other Sites to Swap Crypto Wallet Addresses
items.summary: Malicious code served through the website testing platform replaced visitors' wallet addresses with the attacker's and skimmed cards.

items.title: Nvidia Board Not Considering Jensen Huang's Return: Report
items.summary: The board is focused on its probe into the ousted co-founder, a source told CNBC, despite Donald Trump and Elon Musk backing his return.

items.title: Judge Acquits MIT Brothers in $25M Ethereum MEV Case, Ending Prosecution
items.summary: A federal judge ruled prosecutors failed to prove the material misrepresentation needed for wire fraud, a year after a jury deadlocked.

items.title: Solana Foundation Backs CoinGecko as Crypto Data Giant Eyes Trading
items.summary: CoinGecko has received backing from the Solana Foundation to expand into market intelligence and explore trading.

items.title: Alibaba's Qwen 4 Max Leads China's AI Agent Race—But You Can't Download It
items.summary: Alibaba's new flagship jumps ahead of Chinese rivals on agent and web design leaderboards, with cheaper API access. The closed model also previews the next generation of open Qwen releases.

items.title: Bitcoin Wallet Maker Trezor Says Customer Data Was Exposed Again
items.summary: A second Trezor shipping partner was breached in three months, exposing buyers' addresses and order details.

items.title: Bitcoin's $2 Billion Liquidation Weekend Leaves Traders Watching $60,000
items.summary: Bitcoin fell near $62,100 as forced liquidations swept crypto markets. ETF withdrawals and a crowded options trade offer a closer look at the damage left behind.

items.title: Hackers Redirected Bitcoin Miner Rewards via AI Attack, Luxor CEO Says
items.summary: Luxor said hackers redirected hashrate from just over a dozen client accounts through its Commander tool, and its CEO blamed a “sophisticated AI-enabled vector.”

items.title: Tom Lee Blames Nvidia and Anthropic IPO for Ethereum Plunge as Bitmine Buys the Dip
items.summary: The firm’s stash fell to $11.8 billion from $14.3 billion a week earlier as ETH slid 28% in two weeks, a “waterfall” drop chairman Tom Lee blames on Nvidia fallout and cash-raising ahead of Anthropic’s IPO.

items.title: Clarity Act Defeat ‘Failure of American Leadership’: Trump’s Former Crypto Chief
items.summary: Former White House crypto chief Patrick Witt said the Clarity Act "lost against the clock," and regulators will now set the rules.
